sentence_stem: I'm sorry, I can't come to your party because
correct_completion: I have to work on Saturday.
full_sentence: I'm sorry, I can't come to your party because I have to work on Saturday.
acceptable_variants: I am visiting my grandmother on Saturday.

options.text: I like your house very much.
options.why_wrong: A compliment does not give a reason for not coming, so it does not complete the 'because' clause.

options.text: the weather is nice in May.
options.why_wrong: A fact about the weather does not explain why the speaker cannot come to the party.

options.text: I have to work on Saturday.
yes, I will be there at six.
options.why_wrong: This says the speaker will come, which contradicts 'I can't come' in the stem.

explanation: 'Because' introduces the reason for the situation in the first clause. After it we need a clause that explains why the speaker cannot come. Polish speakers may expect a comma before 'because', but in this sentence no comma is needed.
translation: Przepraszam, nie mogę przyjść na twoją imprezę, ponieważ muszę pracować w sobotę.
